items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Because when I came in, Chick Webb wanted me to -- just you like you say, straw boss -- take over everything, you know.

ctx.x: And he came back to the Savoy and he had a little -- and the band was beginning to -- After I had got back, we had moved the band a little bit -- a step little bit more.
Because when I came in, Chick Webb wanted me to -- just you like you say, straw boss -- take over everything, you know.
Take some of the worries off of his shoulder, you know. This began to move the band up, because then we got more things done.
